tool.name: Multimodal Learner
tool.description: Train and evaluate an AutoGluon Multimodal model

exit_code.description: Error occurred. Please check Tool Standard Error

tool.command:
#import re #set $dollar = '$$' #set $image_column = getattr($use_images_conditional, 'image_column', None) #set $image_columns = getattr($use_images_conditional, 'image_columns', None) #set $images_zip = getattr($use_images_conditional, 'images_zip', None) #set $images_zips = getattr($use_images_conditional, 'images_zips', None) #set $image_folders = getattr($use_images_conditional, 'image_folders', None)
#if $input_csv #set $sanitized_input_csv = re.sub('[^\\w\\-_\\.]','_', $input_csv.element_identifier.strip()) ln -sf '$input_csv' "./${sanitized_input_csv}"; #end if #if $input_test #set $sanitized_test_csv = re.sub('[^\\w\\-_\\.]','_', $input_test.element_identifier.strip()) ln -sf '$input_test' "./${sanitized_test_csv}"; #end if
python '$__tool_directory__/multimodal_learner.py' --input_csv_train "./${sanitized_input_csv}" #if $input_test --input_csv_test "./${sanitized_test_csv}" #end if --target_column '$target_column'
#if $image_columns --image_columns $image_columns #end if #if $image_column --image_column '$image_column' #end if #if $images_zip --images_zip '$images_zip' #end if #if $images_zips --images_zips $images_zips #end if #if $image_folders --image_folders $image_folders #end if #if $missing_image_strategy --missing_image_strategy '$missing_image_strategy' #end if
#if $threshold not in (None, '') --threshold $threshold #end if
#if $time_limit --time_limit $time_limit #end if #if $validation_size not in (None, '') --validation_size $validation_size #end if #if $split_probabilities #set $split_probs = [p.strip() for p in str($split_probabilities).replace(',', ' ').split()] #if len($split_probs) == 3 --split_probabilities ${" ".join($split_probs)} #end if #end if #if $val_size_with_test not in (None, '') --val_size_with_test $val_size_with_test #end if
#if $cross_validation --cross_validation '$cross_validation' #end if #if $num_folds not in (None, '') --num_folds $num_folds #end if #if $epochs not in (None, '') --epochs $epochs #end if #if $learning_rate not in (None, '') --learning_rate $learning_rate #end if #if $batch_size not in (None, '') --batch_size $batch_size #end if
#if $backbone_image --backbone_image '$backbone_image' #end if #if $backbone_text --backbone_text '$backbone_text' #end if #if $backbone_tabular --backbone_tabular '$backbone_tabular' #end if
#if $presets --presets $presets #end if #if $preset --preset '$preset' #end if #if $eval_metric --eval_metric '$eval_metric' #end if #if $hyperparameters --hyperparameters '$hyperparameters' #end if
#if $random_seed not in (None, '') --random_seed '$random_seed' #end if
--output_csv '$output_csv' --output_json '$output_json' --output_html '$output_html' &&
mkdir -p '$output_model.extra_files_path' && MODEL_DIR='' MODEL_DIR_FILE='predictor_path.txt' &&
echo 'Multimodal Learner experiment is done!'

param.name: input_csv
param.label: Multimodal input dataset
param.help: CSV with features (and optional image paths)

param.name: input_test
param.label: Multimodal Test dataset
param.help: If omitted, a split is created from the input dataset

param.name: images_zips
param.label: Images ZIPs (space/comma separated paths)
param.help: One or more image ZIP paths (space/comma separated) to extract for image lookup

param.name: image_folders
param.label: Image folders (space/comma separated)
param.help: Additional folders to search for images

param.name: missing_image_strategy
param.label: Drop rows with missing images
param.help: If true, drop rows with missing image paths; if false (default), fill with placeholder image

param.name: threshold
param.label: Binary decision threshold
param.help: If set (0–1), use this cutoff to convert probabilities to labels for Train/Val/Test metrics and plots.

param.name: val_size_with_test
param.label: Validation fraction (when test CSV is provided)

param.name: cross_validation
param.label: Use cross-validation
param.help: If true, run k-fold cross-validation on train+val combined

param.name: num_folds
param.label: Number of folds
param.help: Number of folds when cross_validation is enabled

param.name: backbone_image
param.label: Image backbone
param.help: Image backbone / timm checkpoint name (e.g., resnet50)

param.name: presets
param.label: Presets (space or comma separated)
param.help: One or more AutoGluon presets to use

param.name: hyperparameters
param.label: Hyperparameters (JSON or shorthand)
param.help: Pass AutoGluon hyperparameters as a JSON string or shorthand

tool.help: **AutoGluon Multimodal Learner** Trains and evaluates an AutoGluon MultiModal model using tabular data and, optionally, images.
